$comment: Inputs to a hostd release (plan 458 W7). celld: upstream denoland/celld release assets, sha256 and size checked against the downloaded bytes; keep the version in step with CELLD_VERSION in .github/workflows/test.yml. caddy: no upstream release ships the caddy-ratelimit module, so .github/workflows/hostd-release.yml builds this Caddy version with these modules at these commits (xcaddy) and attaches the gzipped binaries to the hostd-v<version> release; make-release-manifest.mjs hashes those built files. It refuses to sign while any input is missing or a PLACEHOLDER.
